body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete 

## From #32598: purine-containing compound grouping terms

| GO ID | Term | Proposed replacement |
|---|---|---|
| GO:0043101 | purine-containing compound salvage (also on sjm41's #21578 list) | replaced_by GO:0032261 purine nucleotide salvage |
| GO:0072521 | purine-containing compound metabolic process | consider GO:0006163, GO:0042278, GO:0006144 |
| GO:0072522 | purine-containing compound biosynthetic process | consider GO:0006164, GO:0042451, GO:0009113 |
| GO:0072523 | purine-containing compound catabolic process | consider GO:0006195, GO:0006152, GO:0006145 |
| GO:0072530 | purine-containing compound transmembrane transport | consider GO:1904823, GO:0015860, GO:0015865 |

## From #21578: purine salvage children

| GO ID | Term | Proposed replacement |
|---|---|---|
| GO:0043098 | purine deoxyribonucleoside salvage | replaced_by GO:0106381 purine deoxyribonucleotide salvage |
| GO:0006180 | deoxyguanosine salvage | replaced_by GO:0106384 dGMP salvage |
| GO:0006191 | deoxyinosine salvage | replaced_by GO:0106385 dIMP salvage |
| GO:0043096 | purine nucleobase salvage | replaced_by GO:0106380 purine ribonucleotide salvage |
| GO:0006168 | adenine salvage | replaced_by GO:0044209 AMP salvage |
| GO:0006178 | guanine salvage | replaced_by GO:0032263 GMP salvage |
| GO:0043103 | hypoxanthine salvage | replaced_by GO:0032264 IMP salvage |
| GO:0006166 | purine ribonucleoside salvage | replaced_by GO:0106380 purine ribonucleotide salvage |
| GO:0006169 | adenosine salvage | replaced_by GO:0044209 AMP salvage |
| GO:0006179 | guanosine salvage | replaced_by GO:0032263 GMP salvage |
| GO:0006190 | inosine salvage | consider GO:0032264 IMP salvage, GO:0006204 IMP catabolic process (not replaced_by) |

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32598, https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/21578

The reason for obsoletion is: 
*  The reason for obsoletion is that these terms are an unnecessary grouping terms ([#32598)](https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32598)
* The reason for obsoletion is that these terms were created in error (https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/21578).


Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 

https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1mWxeNwciRFM2shlhA-sY3UYFeiXDmFPfJuXRFAdtaNQ/edit?usp=sharing
